graph_audit.semantic_fit_score_definition: edge-weighted semantic fit minus the same semantic measured on the official distance graph

difficulty_audit.validation_prediction_rule: mean of the preceding 144 Patv_clean_for_input values, repeated for H10 and physically clipped
